answer: Whistle bounty: a wallet that proves two answers share one funding tree earns 10 percent of the slashed reward, paid after 6 epochs. Dune is the evidence file: both funding paths must be on chain. Falcon is the claimant, who posts a deposit of 3 times the expected bounty. Timber is the escrow holding that deposit until a panel of 5 rules. Failure mode: rivals file false claims to freeze honest wallets. Check rule: audits flag claimants with over 40 percent rejected claims. Cheapest bypass: file only weak claims unless deposits scale with claim count.
